watchdog_ngos_searched: Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN)
adversarial_framing_note: Lead Regional story names Saudi Arabia in a geopolitical/security context (US-Iran de-escalation, Trump halting strikes after Gulf/Saudi pressure). Checked Al Jazeera, Middle East Eye, and Iranian state media (Press TV, Tehran Times, Mehr, Tasnim) for framing casting Saudi/Gulf adversarially. Al Jazeera/MEE framed Saudi as a de-escalating actor (not adversarial). One in-window Iranian-state-media item (Press TV, 2026-08-02) frames the 'Persian Gulf states' collectively as having 'handed over their sovereignty' to enable an illegal war on Iran; implicates Saudi as the leading Gulf monarchy but does not name it. Included as a Negative Articles item, clearly flagged as Iranian state media and collective in scope.
